For those of you traveling to celebrate ileya festival
If you must use the Lagos-Ibadan expressway between 5th and 7th June, be prepared to encounter heavy traffic  on the road.

1. 6th June is RCCG Holy ghost service
2. 6th June is the Sallah day
3. 7th June is MFM Power Must Change Hands.

Traffic advisory provided by Mobility✌️
